content.text:
The app is running and ready for you to test. It's process 14892 and the window is titled "test - OrcaSlicer".

- **Pull:** the branch was already up to date with the remote, at `318208608f`.
- **Build:** the Release build finished with nothing to recompile, so the existing binaries already matched the latest code. The software OpenGL files this machine needs (it has no GPU) are in place next to the app.
- **Agent page:** I rebuilt it from source and it came out the same as the copy in the repo, so the working tree is still clean.
- **Launch:** I started `build\src\Release\orca-slicer.exe` with your normal data folder, not a separate test one. It reopened your last project ("test") and is responding.
